$comment: The model registry and routing policy. Models are data: add or adjust one in your own ~/.claude/model-router.json, or per project in .claude/model-router.json (same shape, merged key by key). strength and cost are relative ranks. A model's name must be an alias the Agent tool accepts (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable); `twins` are other names the same model is offered under, so an ID with one is held to the cap as that model, while availableModels and deniedModels match it by its own name. Levels pair a strength with an effort: a level runs on the cheapest model at or above its strength, so lookup and standard both run on Haiku, at medium and high, complex on Sonnet at high, hardest on Opus at high and frontier on Fable at high. A model named on a call stands for its lowest level, or the level its named effort reaches, and gets that level's effort when nobody chose one. A model weaker than a level needs runs it one effort step higher, up to xhigh. Model Router prices nothing: /model-router:usage shows Claude Code's own estimate. `schema` is the version of this shape; an override may carry it too, and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Compatibility" says what changes it.

haiku.use_for: Finding, reading and listing at medium effort; writing and fixing code, figures and documents to a brief at high.

sonnet.use_for: A judgment call with no check to run, such as a design or a review.

opus.use_for: The hardest level: a redo of work Sonnet fell short on, or a level a rule raises to it.

fable.use_for: The top level: a redo of work Opus fell short on, or a level a rule raises to it.

session.$comment: The main session's recommended setups: each family's lowest effort for the session that plans and delegates. A family left out is never recommended. The session check offers them in this order. Read from this file only.

newest.$comment: The newest full model ID of each family that some provider's alias lags behind. Every provider in older_aliases takes this Claude API form: Bedrock and Agent Platform map it to their own ID, Foundry sends it as the deployment name, and Claude Platform on AWS and Claude Models on Google Cloud use it as is (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview.md).

older_aliases.$comment: Per provider, each family whose alias resolves to an older model than newest names, and the ID of that model (the alias table in https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config.md). The mod sends the newest ID for these instead of the alias.
